# AMEVA-Sentinel Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Privacy-First 0-Data Browser Observability & Deterministic 0~100 Threat Scoring SDK
Evaluates client structural signals entirely locally without capturing user inputs, computing deterministic 0~100 risk score and HMAC-SHA256 tokens.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: 
- Command: npm install ameva-sentinel
# or CDN:
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/ameva-sentinel/dist/sentinel.min.js"></script>
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/ameva-sentinel
